Welcome to Clay

Onboarding at Clay is a cohort experience — and one of the most Clay things we do. Every new Claymate travels to Clay HQ in New York City, meets their new hire class on day one, bonds with their team, learns how we work, and builds — with Clay the product, and actual clay itself 🏺. We're excited to go on this journey with you!
Upcoming events

We love to have fun at Clay, and would love to have you join us! Click here to see all of our upcoming events and feel free to RSVP for anything, even before your start date. If you have any questions, reach out to our Employee Experience Curator, Erin Zarr.

P.S. We're always adding new events, and this link stays up to date!

GETTING READY

Logistics

  • Book onboarding travel (if outside NYC)

    We invite every Claymate to onboard at Clay HQ for their first two weeks.

    • You will receive a Navan invite two weeks before your start date so you can book your flight and hotel.
    • If you have not received an invite two weeks before you start, please contact onboarding@clay.com
    • When booking, please refer to our travel policy.
    • If, based on the booking options, you need to book something outside of policy, please email onboarding@clay.com to explain and we can approve on the backend.
    Week two

    Week two is optional, but encouraged! It's a great opportunity to immerse yourself in Clay's culture and spend more time connecting and collaborating with your team.

    Non-customer-facing roles

    There are no formal onboarding sessions during week two, so the 2nd week of in-person onboarding time is best spent working alongside your team and getting more familiar with your role.

    GTM/customer-facing roles

    Product onboarding sessions continue into week two, so staying allows you to attend these sessions in person. All sessions are also available via Zoom if needed, and most take place between 9 AM and 12 PM ET.

  • Start exploring Clay (encouraged)
    Get a head start with Clay 101

    You'll receive an invitation to Clay 101, our self-paced learning course hosted on Uplimit, at your personal email address. The course takes approximately 10 hours to complete and is optional, but encouraged if you'd like to start familiarizing yourself with the product.

    A quick heads-up: we've shipped so much this summer that some of the content is a little outdated (our bad!). It's still a great resource for learning the fundamentals, and you can find additional, up-to-date content at Clay University.

    Join the Clay Community Slack

    Connect with the broader Clay community, explore how others are using the product, and get inspired. You can use your personal email to join for now.

    Clay Community Slack →

Week before

The week before

3 days before
  • Set up your Clay email — you'll get access to your Clay email and other tools 3 days before you start. Instructions will be sent to your personal email. If you don't have access by Friday, please let us know at onboarding@clay.com.
  • Accept Slack & Notion invites after logging into your Clay email.
Friday afternoon
  • Download Parkday to order lunch. Menu drops Sunday night — order by 9am Monday.
Sunday
  • Order lunch on Parkday before 9am. We recommend ordering for the whole week.
  • For US-based Claymates, gather I-9 documents to bring Monday. Acceptable documents →
  • Plan to arrive between 9:30–10am, for your first session at 10am. Dress code: wear what makes you feel like you.
Day one

Your first day

Our New York HQ address is

11 Madison Avenue, Floor 14, New York, NY 10010.

Badge access

If your badge access isn't set up by Monday, you can enter the building and sign in as a guest.

Finding us

Once you reach the 14th floor, head to the front desk on the north side of the floor (turn left from the left elevator bank or right from the right elevator bank). Our lovely Workplace team will be there to greet you and guide you to the new hire breakfast.

A quick note: Please plan to arrive no earlier than 9:30 AM so we have everything ready to give you a warm welcome!

9:30 AM
Breakfast
14th floor kitchen — meet your cohort and fellow Claymates!
Morning
The full morning
Benefits run through, Clay history, office tour, and laptop setup.
Lunch
Cohort lunch
Get to know your fellow new hire cohort!
Afternoon
Meet your onboarding buddy
1:1 to get your questions answered.
Complete by end of day
  • Join your onboarding calendar: All New Hires · Clay Experts (GTM/CX) · Engineering · PSS · Foundations
  • Set up Slack — add full name, title, and phone number.
  • Generate your email signature
  • Complete Vanta security onboarding
  • Set up 2-factor authentication for Gmail.
  • Accept your 1Password invite. It will expire within 24 hours.
This week (whenever works)
  • Post on LinkedIn that you joined Clay. Grab a banner here
First week

Your first week

General onboarding is ~3 days. Role-specific onboarding varies.

DayWhat's happening
Day 1Set up & settle in.
Day 2Team reflection activity and tooling session.
Day 3Lunch and Lore panel and pottery class activity
Day 4Block time to learn Clay and sit with your buddy to go through what you built.
Day 5First week done!
